dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: I always love to take a stroll around the night market after a performance.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: This street has a striking resemblance to those back in Liyue. It really feels just like being there.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Let's take a stroll around here tonight, then. What do you say?
